newsitem.title: ALBANIA: Firefighters halt oil blaze near Albania port.
newsitem.headline: Firefighters halt oil blaze near Albania port.

text.p: An oil storage tank caught fire near the Adriatic port of Vlore on Wednesday but police said they did not suspect it was connected with recent unrest in Albania.
Firefighters from Vlore and other nearby towns contained the fire and stopped it from spreading to seven other storage tanks at the coastal site, where oil is pumped on to tankers.
A big cloud of smoke billowed over the area, some two km (one mile) from the Vlore town centre.
The tanks, which each contain some 5,000 cubic metres of oil, belong to the Albanian oil company Albpetrol-Tranagat.

A correspondent in the town said police suspected that local farmers had been burning grass and weeds in a 10-metre wide canal which sometimes carries oil waste. The oil remnants may have ignited and spread to one of the storage tanks, police said.
"The danger is over," deputy minister of energy Dashamir Mezini said.
